title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يلقي الكلمة الافتتاحية في المؤتمر الدولي للوسطية‎
title_en: The Sheikh Delivers the Opening Address at the International Conference on Moderation
body_ar: ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو حفظه الله تعالى صباح اليوم 14 فبراير 2015 الكلمة الافتتاحية في المؤتمر الدولي للوسطية المنعقد في العاصمة السنغالية دكار و الذي ينظمه التجمع الإسلامي في السنغال ويستمر لمدة يومين بحضور مشاركين من معظم الدول الإسلامية في إفريقيا وممثلين عن منظمات إسلامية في أوروبا ؛ وقد تناول فضيلة الشيخ في كلمته أسس الوسطية و مظاهر تطبيقها مبينا " أن الدين يسر ولن يشاد أحد الدين إلا غلبه " .. كما تحدث الشيخ عن مجالات الوسطية وأجملها فيما يلي : العقيدة السلوك الفقه الأصالة والمعاصرة السياسة والحكم العلم والعمل العلاقات الدولية الاقتصاد و في ختام كلمته نبه فضيلة الشيخ أن هذه المجالات لم تكتمل فقد بقي منها ثلاثة ضاق عنها الوقت .
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew (may God the Exalted preserve him) delivered this morning, 14 February 2015, the opening address at the International Conference on Moderation, held in the Senegalese capital Dakar, organised by the Islamic Assembly in Senegal. It runs for two days, with participants from most of the Muslim countries of Africa and representatives of Islamic organisations in Europe.

In his address the Sheikh treated the foundations of moderation and the ways it is put into practice, setting out that "the religion is ease, and no one will contend with the religion but it will overcome him".

The Sheikh also spoke of the fields of moderation, summarising them as follows: creed; conduct; jurisprudence; authenticity and contemporaneity; politics and governance; knowledge and action; international relations; the economy.

At the close of his address the Sheikh pointed out that these fields were not complete: three of them remained, for which there had not been time.

flags.context: throughout: المؤتمر الدولي للوسطية, أسس الوسطية, مجالات الوسطية
flags.note: وسطية is the abstract noun from the Qur'anic أمة وسطا (Sūrat al-Baqarah 2:143) and carries 'centrality' and 'balance' as much as 'moderation', which in English has acquired a political colouring the Arabic does not have here. 'Moderation' is used as the established rendering. Not in the project glossary; it recurs across the corpus — record 882 in this slice is a whole lecture on it — and should be fixed corpus-wide.

flags.arabic: " أن الدين يسر ولن يشاد أحد الدين إلا غلبه "
flags.context: the text quoted in the address
options: no one will contend with the religion but it will overcome him
no one will overburden himself in religion but it will defeat him
no one will make the religion hard on himself but it will get the better of him
flags.note: A prophetic report; the Sheikh gives no narrator or collection and none has been added. شادّ is to strain against or vie with: the sense is that anyone who forces the religion beyond its ease is worsted by it. The three renderings differ in how much interpretation they carry; the first is the most literal.

flags.arabic: فقد بقي منها ثلاثة ضاق عنها الوقت
options: three of them remained, for which there had not been time
flags.note: The Sheikh himself says his enumeration is incomplete. That admission must be kept: eight fields are listed and he states that three more were not reached. The record does not name them, and they have not been supplied.

translator_notes: A news report. The list of eight fields is run together without punctuation in the Arabic; the English separates them with semicolons and adds nothing.

الأصالة والمعاصرة is a standing pair in modern Arabic thought, roughly rootedness in the tradition set against engagement with the present; rendered literally as 'authenticity and contemporaneity' rather than glossed.
